name: Justice's Theme
source:
While others are distracted by the noise, Justin sees the cracks in the story. And he’s not afraid to dig deeper...

[From [url=https://anows.itch.io/justice-theme]Itch.io[/url]]

当旁人都被周遭的喧嚣分散注意力时，唯有贾斯汀看穿了故事背后的裂痕。而且他绝不畏惧向更深处挖掘真相……
